story.iWant: to view comprehensive performance statistics and summaries
story.soThat: I get a complete overview of my game performance

tasks.task: Create API endpoint for performance summary (AC: #1, #2, #3)
Create domain service for performance statistics calculation (AC: #2)
Create database query for performance summary data (AC: #2, #4)
Integrate performance summary into analytics dashboard (AC: #1, #3)
Add error handling and edge cases (AC: #4, #6)

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Given I have imported game data, When I view the performance summary section, Then the system displays: total games played count, total wins and losses with percentages, average game duration (if available), best performance indicators (longest win streak, best ELO achieved), recent activity summary (games played this week/month), key metrics cards with large, readable numbers and icons

Given I have imported game data, When I view the performance summary, Then the system calculates and displays: total games, total wins, total losses, win percentage, average game duration (if available), longest win streak, best ELO achieved, recent activity (games in last 7 days and last 30 days)

Given I am viewing performance summary, When I apply date range or role filters, Then the system updates all summary statistics to reflect the filtered data, And the metrics cards smoothly animate to the new values, And the filter indicators show active filters

Given I have game duration data available, When I view the performance summary, Then the system displays average game duration in minutes, And if duration data is not available, the system gracefully omits this metric without errors

Given I am viewing performance summary, When the data is loading, Then the system displays loading states (skeleton screens or spinners), And when data is available, it transitions smoothly with animations

Given I have no game data or insufficient data for statistics, When I view the performance summary, Then the system displays an empty state with helpful messaging, And suggests importing game data or selecting a different time range

constraints.constraint: Clean Architecture + Hexagonal Architecture: Analytics components in Presentation Layer (src/components/analytics/), use cases in Application Layer (src/application/use-cases/), domain services in Domain Layer (src/domain/services/), data access through Infrastructure Layer (src/infrastructure/persistence/)

Use repository pattern in Infrastructure Layer for database queries. Create domain services in src/domain/services/ for business logic calculations. Follow established patterns from previous stories (4-1, 4-2, 4-3)

Use TanStack Query for server state (analytics data) with 5min stale time, 10min GC time. Use Zustand for client state (filters) via useAnalyticsStore() hook. Filter changes must trigger data refetch across all analytics components

Use ShadCN/UI Card components for metrics display with custom styling. Use Tailwind CSS 3.3.0 with tailwind-variants for component variants. Maintain responsive design (mobile-first: 320px, 768px, 1024px breakpoints)
API response time target: < 500ms for aggregated data. Filter update target: < 300ms for data refresh. Implement TanStack Query caching, database query optimization (indexes, efficient aggregations)
All analytics endpoints require authentication via NextAuth.js session. Users can only access their own data (player ID must match session user). Admin users can access any player's analytics
Use Zod 4.1.12 for API request/response validation. Add input validation using Zod schemas in route handlers. Return proper error responses (404 for player not found, 400 for invalid parameters)

Maintain minimum 80% test coverage for all new code. Use Vitest 1.0.0 for unit/integration tests, React Testing Library for component tests, Playwright 1.56.1 for E2E tests. Component tests at tests/components/analytics/, integration tests at tests/integration/api/analytics/
Use ApiError class with statusCode property for proper retry logic. Handle edge cases: no games, insufficient data, division by zero, single game data. Display empty states for no performance data

interface.name: PerformanceSummary
interface.signature: interface PerformanceSummary { totalGames: number; totalWins: number; totalLosses: number; winPercentage: number; averageGameDuration?: number; longestWinStreak: number; bestELOAchieved: number; recentActivity: { thisWeek: number; thisMonth: number; }; }

interface.name: GET /api/players/[id]/analytics/summary
interface.signature: GET /api/players/[id]/analytics/summary?dateRange? Query Parameters: dateRange (optional). Response: PerformanceSummary. Error Codes: 404 (Player not found), 400 (Invalid parameters)

interface.name: PerformanceSummaryProps
interface.signature: interface PerformanceSummaryProps { playerId: string; dateRange?: DateRange; }

interface.name: useAnalyticsStore
interface.signature: const useAnalyticsStore = create<AnalyticsState>(). Returns: { dateRange: DateRange | null; roles: PlayerRole[]; setDateRange: (range: DateRange) => void; setRoles: (roles: PlayerRole[]) => void; reset: () => void; }

interface.name: PerformanceStatsAggregator
interface.signature: class PerformanceStatsAggregator { calculateSummary(playerId: string, dateRange?: DateRange, roles?: PlayerRole[]): Promise<PerformanceSummary> }

tests.standards: Maintain minimum 80% test coverage for all new code. Use Vitest 1.0.0 for unit/integration tests with @vitest/coverage-v8. Use React Testing Library 16.0.0 for component tests. Use Playwright 1.56.1 for E2E tests. All tests must be deterministic and not depend on external services. Use mocks for API calls and database queries in unit tests. Integration tests should use test database. Component tests should test rendering, user interactions, loading states, and error states.

test.description: Test PerformanceSummary component renders all metrics cards (total games, wins/losses, win percentage, average duration, win streak, best ELO, recent activity) with correct values

Test PerformanceStatsAggregator service calculates all statistics correctly: total games (COUNT), wins (COUNT where isWinner=true), losses (COUNT where isWinner=false), win percentage ((wins/total)*100), longest win streak (consecutive wins), best ELO (MAX), recent activity (COUNT in last 7/30 days)
Test database query handles edge cases: no games (returns zeros), single game, division by zero (win percentage when totalGames=0), missing duration data (averageGameDuration=undefined)
Test filter integration: when dateRange changes in Zustand store, PerformanceSummary component refetches data and metrics cards animate to new values. Filter indicators show active filters.
Test conditional rendering: when duration data exists, averageGameDuration metric displays. When duration data missing, metric is omitted gracefully without errors.

Test loading states: skeleton screens display while data is fetching, smooth transition animation when data loads. Test empty states: helpful messaging when no data available, suggestions to import data or change time range.
Test empty state: when player has no games or insufficient data, empty state displays with helpful message suggesting to import data or select different time range
Test authentication: API endpoint rejects unauthenticated requests (401), users cannot access other players' data (403), admin users can access any player's data
Test API response time: aggregated data query completes in < 500ms. Test filter update latency: data refresh completes in < 300ms after filter change
Test edge cases: player with 0 games, player with 1 game, player with 1000+ games, date range with no games, role filter with no matches, invalid date range format
